text:
sara: quick shotgun micro-eval results for kuma-9b variants (ran on sample slices, 1k prompts each). posting raw numbers first so we can decide a default quant flag.

sara: variants tested: kuma-9b.fp16, kuma-9b.int8, kuma-9b.int4, kuma-9b.qat-int6 (experimental)

sara: perf snapshot (p50/p95 latency ms | tokens/s | avg accuracy @ eval-suite):
- fp16: 48 / 120 | 200 tok/s | 0.83
- int8: 42 / 150 | 230 tok/s | 0.81
- int4: 36 / 220 | 310 tok/s | 0.74
- qat-int6: 40 / 130 | 260 tok/s | 0.80

miguel: thanks. rough unit-econ calc (cost per 1k tokens, infra only)
- fp16 ~ $0.22
- int8 ~ $0.16
- int4 ~ $0.10
- qat-int6 ~ $0.14

jena: high-level takeaway: int4 gives biggest cost win but accuracy dip is visible on multi-turn dialogue and factual checks. qat-int6 looks promising as compromise.

ankur: can you paste the failure modes? which benchmarks regress?

sara: quick notes: int4 drops on long-context coherence (longform summarization slice) and on named-entity fidelity tests. single-turn QA and chat templates are mostly fine. qat-int6 preserves most fidelity with small latency gain.

sara: minimal sample logs:
```
# sample diff (reference vs int4)
Q: summarize meeting notes about product roadmap
REF: "Team decided to prioritize infra stability; roadmap includes canary rollout for routing and a cost-savings spike at Q3."
INT4: "Team wants to prioritize stability; roadmap includes a rollout and cost savings in Q3."
-> lost the 'canary' and 'routing' terms on 12% of cases in this slice.
```

miguel: for product / GTN decision: if we default to int6 (qat-int6), we get ~30% infra cost reduction vs fp16 with <3% quality delta on our weighted score. seems reasonable as default for non-sensitive routes.

lucy-prod: product angle: which routes should be gated to fp16? I propose: chat assistant longform, legal/contract summarization, and re-ranking/rerank endpoints. others use int6.

jena: agree. suggest we create a small routing flag: `kuma-9b:variant=default(int6)` and allow route-level overrides. also add per-route eval hooks to watch for regressions.

ankur: ops-bot, can you auto-deploy a canary with int6 for 10% traffic and set up alerts on the two slices (longform and NER fidelity)?

ops-bot: @ankur scheduled canary deployment: model=kuma-9b.qat-int6, traffic=10%, start=3301234660. Alert hooks created: eval.longform_coherence, eval.ner_fidelity.

miguel: quick checklist before we flip defaults:
- product signoff on fp16 gate list (lucy) :thumbsup:
- add prompt-level guardrails for NER-sensitive flows (jena)
- monitoring: p50/p95 latency, avg score, and per-slice delta (miguel)
- rollback policy and fallback to fp16 with auto-rollback if score delta > 4% (sara)

sara: I'm going to run a fuller 10k sample overnight with traffic-sim weighting and post an updated unit-econ + scorecard tomorrow morning.

lucy-prod: love it, thanks. initial stance: default to qat-int6 for public API, keep strict fp16 for legal/longform endpoints. will sync with GTN on rollout comms.

jena: small prod note: check KV cache size changes with int4/int6 — we saw larger cache hit variance in earlier models, could affect latency tail.

ankur: noted. ops-bot, include KV cache metric in the canary dashboard.

ops-bot: dashboard updated: metrics added -> kv_cache_hit_ratio, p95_latency, per_slice_accuracy_deltas.

sara: thanks everyone. action items captured. will post final scorecard + recommended routing flags in this thread after full run. :coffee:
